Data Processing Agreement - DPA-2026377

Controller: Acme Corp
Processor: AnalyticsCo
Date: 2026-10-02
Classification: CONFIDENTIAL

Categories of Personal Data:
- Customer contact information (email, phone, address)
- Payment card data (tokenized)
- National ID numbers (where legally required)
- Usage analytics and behavioral data

Processing Purposes:
1. Service delivery and support
2. Billing and payment processing
3. Legal compliance and reporting
4. Security and fraud prevention

Technical Measures:
- Encryption at rest: AES-256
- Encryption in transit: TLS 1.3
- Access controls: RBAC with MFA
- Audit logging: 7-year retention

Subprocessors:
SubProcessor A (EU)

Data Subject Rights:
Processed per Articles 12-23 GDPR. Contact: dpo@company.com
